blurb: Shearwater Sailing is based in Monterey California. We offer local and offshore sailing charters and wildlife viewing onboard the modern classic sailing yacht Atalanta. Join yachtsman Kevin Wasbauer for a unique and restorative experience on the waters of the Monterey Bay Marine
